# Solitaire (Klondike)

> A free, open-source Klondike Solitaire card game built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Play the classic single-player card game directly in your web browser with drag-and-drop support, animations, and automatic move detection.

## About

Solitaire is a browser-based implementation of the classic Klondike Solitaire card game. It features a modern UI with smooth animations powered by Framer Motion, drag-and-drop card interactions via @dnd-kit, and a responsive design that works on desktop and mobile devices.

Key features:
- Classic Klondike Solitaire gameplay with standard rules
- Drag-and-drop card movement
- Automatic card placement to foundations
- Move history and undo functionality
- Game state tracking with win detection
- Difficulty scoring and completion progress
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile
- Smooth animations and visual feedback
- No account required, no ads, fully client-side

## Technology

- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Tailwind CSS 4
- State management: Zustand 5
- Drag and drop: @dnd-kit 6
- Animations: Framer Motion 12
- Build: Vite 7, pnpm workspaces
- Hosting: GitHub Pages

## Architecture

- [Game core library](https://github.com/chayuto/Solitaire/tree/main/packages/core): Pure TypeScript game logic with zero dependencies — card types, deck utilities, game rules, move validation, and scoring
- [MCTS solver](https://github.com/chayuto/Solitaire/tree/main/packages/mcts): Monte Carlo Tree Search solver for the game (placeholder)
- [Web application](https://github.com/chayuto/Solitaire/tree/main/packages/app): React-based UI with Zustand store, drag-and-drop, and animations
